recognize_zh: 周邊血液抹片的羽狀邊緣可見一片黏在一起的細胞群：核為卵圓形、染色質均勻、無明顯核仁，胞質淡藍且邊界不清，呈平鋪的片狀排列；上方只有正常的嗜中性球。這種外觀溫和、成片出現的細胞是抽血時刮下的血管內皮細胞，不是白血病細胞。
features: Cohesive sheet-like cluster of cells lying within the red cell monolayer at the feathered edge
Medium-to-large cells with oval to elongated nuclei, some indented or grooved
Evenly distributed, finely granular chromatin without prominent nucleoli
Moderate pale blue cytoplasm with indistinct cell borders forming a syncytial arrangement
One elongated spindle-shaped nucleus within the cluster; admixed platelets and a few neutrophils
Uninvolved background shows normal neutrophils and red cells
describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows, near the feathered edge, a cohesive sheet of medium-to-large cells with oval to elongated, occasionally grooved nuclei, fine evenly dispersed chromatin, inconspicuous nucleoli, and ample pale blue cytoplasm with indistinct borders. The cells lack the high N:C ratio, fine blastic chromatin, or nucleoli of leukemic blasts and lack the basophilic cytoplasmic skirt of reactive lymphocytes. The background contains unremarkable neutrophils and red cells. Findings are consistent with endothelial cells dislodged during venipuncture, a benign artifact.

ddx.vs: Blasts circulate as discrete, non-cohesive cells with high N:C ratio, fine chromatin and nucleoli, not as bland syncytial sheets with abundant pale cytoplasm.
Reactive lymphocytes are single cells whose deeply basophilic cytoplasm hugs adjacent red cells, rather than cohesive clusters of oval-nucleated cells.
Tumor cells show nuclear pleomorphism, hyperchromasia, prominent nucleoli and increased N:C ratio, whereas these nuclei are uniform and bland.
Megakaryocytic nuclei are dense and lobulated with granular cytoplasm and attached platelets, unlike the uniform oval nuclei here.
